extracted.intended_audience: patent examiners, PCT practitioners, patent attorneys, and applicants handling international (PCT) applications and U.S. national-stage filings
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural and substantive standards from the MPEP for preparing, filing, processing, amending, searching, publishing, and entering international (PCT) applications and related national-stage (U.S.) matters, including authorities' duties, fees, deadlines, and form/language requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Copy of amendment under Article 19 sent (communicated) to DO
rubrics_metrics.description: When Article 19 claim amendments are made, a copy of the amendment must be communicated/sent to each Designated Office (DO).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Referenced: Art. 20, Rule 47.1(b). See related processing rules for amendments before ISA/IB/IPEA/DO/EO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition and form of amendment before IPEA
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition and required form of amendments filed under Article 34 (before the International Preliminary Examining Authority).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: References: Rule 66.5 (definition), Rule 66.8 (form). See A.I. 515 and Rule 66 series for processing and form guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Language of amendments to the IA
rubrics_metrics.description: Amendments to the international application must comply with language requirements applicable to the IA and the receiving/transmitting authorities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Rule 66.8 and related A.I. entries for specifics on acceptable languages and translations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Processing of Article 19 amendment by IB
rubrics_metrics.description: How the International Bureau processes amendments made under Article 19.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Rule 12.2 and A.I. 417 for the IB processing procedures and communications to DOs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Processing of amendments by IPEA
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures the IPEA follows when processing Article 34 amendments and other submissions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See A.I. 602 and A.I. 515 for IPEA processing guidance and timing rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correction/amendment of abstract by ISA
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedure and rules for correction or amendment of the abstract by the International Searching Authority (ISA).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Art. 28, Rule 52 and A.I. 515 for operations regarding abstracts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment of claims before DO/IB/IB/EO/IPEA
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules governing amendment of claims before Designated Offices (DO), the International Bureau (IB), the Examining Office (EO), the ISA/IB, and the IPEA under Articles 19, 34, 41, and related rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: References: Art. 19, Rule 46; Art. 34 Rule 66.3; Art. 41, Rule 78; Art. 28, Rule 52; 37 CFR 1.485; A.I. 205. See separate entries for numbering/identification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Numbering and identification of claims in amendment
rubrics_metrics.description: When claims are amended, they must be numbered and identified according to the rules for amendments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See A.I. 205 and Rule references (Art. 28, Rule 52; Art. 41, Rule 78). U.S. practice: 37 CFR 1.436.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment/processing of description before IPEA/DO/EO
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and procedures for amending the description of the IA before IPEA, DO, and EO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: References: Art. 34 Rule 66.3; Art. 28 Rule 52; Art. 41 Rule 78; 37 CFR 1.485; see A.I. 204.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment/processing of drawings before DO/EO/IPEA
rubrics_metrics.description: How drawings (including flowsheets and diagrams) are treated and amended before DO/EO and IPEA; rules for missing drawings and time to file.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: References: Art. 28 Rule 52; Art. 41 Rule 78; Art. 34; Rule 7.1; Rule 20.5; A.I. 310; 37 CFR 1.437.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sheets later submitted for incorporation by reference
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for including later-submitted sheets into the IA by incorporation by reference.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Rule 88, Art. 58 and A.I. 309 for incorporation by reference rules and processing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant changes before RO/US; recording by USPTO if U.S. designated
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for recording changes to applicants (name, address, person) before the Receiving Office and the U.S. Office when U.S. is designated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See 37 CFR 1.472 and A.I. 329, A.I. 313; rules for transmitting notices of change between authorities (A.I. 328, A.I. 425, A.I. 512, A.I. 608).

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability/translation of IA to IB
rubrics_metrics.description: Availability and translation obligations for the international application to the International Bureau.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See 37 CFR 3.21 and Rule 43.8, Rule 70.14, A.I. 514, A.I. 612 for translation availability and procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biological material inventions — deposited material indications
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for indicating deposited biological material (e.g., microorganism deposits) in the IA and providing separate sheet indications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Rule 13 bis and A.I. 209, Rule 13 ter and A.I. 335, and associated annexes for sequence listings and deposit disclosure rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nucleotide or amino acid sequence listing requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for sequence listings accompanying an IA and treatment by the RO/ISA/IB.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Rule 5.2, A.I. Annex C, Rule 13 ter, A.I. Annex C, and 37 CFR 1.435 for U.S. regulation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Calendar/dates format — use Gregorian calendar
rubrics_metrics.description: Dates in the IA must use the Gregorian calendar and follow prescribed formats.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Rule 79 and related references on date format and time computations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Changes in person, name or address of applicants and inventors (international phase)
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and rules for recording changes in applicant/inventor identity or contact details during the international phase.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See 37 CFR 1.472, 37 CFR 1.41(e), 37 CFR 1.48, Rule 3.3, A.I. 313 and A.I. 328 for notice transmission between authorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Citations (proper) of documents in the ISR
rubrics_metrics.description: How documents should be cited in the International Search Report (ISR), including method of identifying documents and indications of relevance and special categories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See A.I. 503, A.I. 505, A.I. 507, A.I. 508 and Rule 42/Rule 45/Rule 72 for practice on citation identification and categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Claims — general rules and amendment procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: General rules for claims in the IA: initial drafting, numbering, amendments under Articles 19 and 34, and annotations required by RO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: References: Art. 6 Rule 6; Art. 28 Rule 52; Art. 41 Rule 78; Art. 19 Rule 46; Art. 34 Rule 66.4/66.8; A.I. 205; 37 CFR 1.436.

rubrics_metrics.name: Classification of IA subject matter
rubrics_metrics.description: How subject matter of an international application is classified for search/examination purposes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See A.I. 504 and Art. 56 and related Rules on classification and the committee established by the assembly of states.

rubrics_metrics.name: Common representative — appointment and change
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules concerning the appointment of a common representative for applicants and procedures to notify authorities of changes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Rule 2.2 bis, Rule 90.2, A.I. 106, and notification procedures (A.I. 328, A.I. 425, A.I. 512, A.I. 608).

rubrics_metrics.name: Communications from IB — content and transmission
rubrics_metrics.description: IB communications of IA, ISR, Article 17(2)(a) determinations, and indications that no search will be established to each DO, including electronic transmission rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: References: Art. 20, Rule 47; Rule 89 bis; A.I. 701-714; A.I. Annex F; Rule 59 and A.I. 420 for copies to ISA/IPEA/DOs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Confidential nature of certain communications/materials
rubrics_metrics.description: Certain communications and materials in the international procedure are to be kept confidential according to PCT articles and national law.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Art. 30 and Art. 38 and relevant implementing provisions for confidential handling by ISA/IPEA/IB/DOs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Confirmation copy of facsimile transmission (N/A in U.S.)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements regarding confirmation copies for facsimile transmissions to authorities; U.S. exceptions noted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Rule 92.4 and A.I. 331 for facsimile transmission procedures and U.S. exceptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Continuation/continuation-in-part treatment of IA in designated states
rubrics_metrics.description: How an IA is treated as a continuation or continuation-in-part in any designated state and the consequences for national stage processing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Rule 4.11, 49 bis.1(d) and related A.I. notes for treatment and filing consequences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Copies of IA — record, search, home copy; electronic copies
rubrics_metrics.description: Obligations to prepare and transmit record copy (RC), search copy (SC), and home copy (HC) by RO; requirements for copies in electronic form and handling of paper-to-electronic conversions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Rule 21, A.I. 305/A.I. 305 bis, Rule 23, Rule 22, Rule 89 ter, A.I. 706, and A.I. 307-310 for copy preparation, identification (RC/SC/HC), and transmission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Making home copy and search copy from original IA by RO; identifying RC/SC/HC
rubrics_metrics.description: RO procedures for making HC and SC from the original IA, and marking/identifying the RC, SC, and HC.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Art. 12, Rule 21 and A.I. 305, A.I. 804(d) for marking and identification guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correction of request by RO ex officio
rubrics_metrics.description: Circumstances in which the Receiving Office may correct the request ex officio and procedures for doing so.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See A.I. 327 and Rule references for scope of ex officio corrections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Corrections and amendments during international processing
rubrics_metrics.description: Permitted corrections and amendments during international processing and the procedures to present them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Rule 26, Rule 46, and related A.I. guidance for timing and authority-specific limitations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correspondence — addressing, to whom sent, general rules
rubrics_metrics.description: General rules governing correspondence in the international procedure, including to whom applicant correspondence should be sent and response procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See A.I. 108 and Rule 92 for general correspondence handling and address of record rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dates and time limits — general rules and format
rubrics_metrics.description: General rules for computing dates and time limits (using Gregorian calendar), including deadlines applicable to applicants and authorities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Rule 79, A.I. 110, Rule 82, and many specific Rule/Art references for time limits and computation methods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deadlines and extensions - actions before RO, ISA, IPEA, DO/EO
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific deadlines and available extensions for applicants to take actions before the Receiving Office, ISA, IPEA, and Designated/Examining Offices (e.g., correcting defects, paying fees, filing demands, submitting priority documents).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Rule 22.1, Art. 14(1)(b), Rule 26.2, Art. 11(2), Rule 20; Rule 16 bis; Rule 17.1; Rule 46.1; Rule 66/66.1/66.4 bis; Rule 60.1; Rule 66.7; Rule 66.2; 37 CFR provisions cited (1.484, 1.485, 1.431, etc.). Time for reply to written opinion is non-extendable (37 CFR 1.484(d)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Time for reply to written opinion (non-extendable)
rubrics_metrics.description: Time set in the IPEA written opinion for reply (including Article 34 amendments) is non-extendable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Rule 66.2 and 37 CFR 1.484(d) — replies to written opinion must be within the fixed time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fees — handling, preliminary examination, international filing, search, transmittal, late payment
rubrics_metrics.description: Also includes schedule of fees, time limits for payment, late payment fees, associated refunds, and special publication fees payable to IB.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: References: Rule 57, Rule 58, Rule 58 bis, Rule 96.1, Rule 57.3, Rule 58.1(b), Rule 16 bis, Rule 15/16, Rule 14; 37 CFR 1.482, 1.445, 1.446, 1.492, 1.495 for U.S. regulations. See A.I. 320-324, A.I. 613 for invitations to pay/request refund and A.I. Annex G.

rubrics_metrics.name: Additional fees where lack of unity found
rubrics_metrics.description: When lack of unity is found by ISA or IPEA, additional fees per invention may be required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: References: Art. 34(3) Rule 68 (IPEA/US: 37 CFR 1.482(a)(2)); Art. 17(3) Rule 40 (ISA/US: 37 CFR 1.445(a)(3)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule of fees and refunds; invitations to pay; refunds before IPEA
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for scheduling fees, inviting applicants to pay, and refunding fees (including before IPEA or upon RO invitation).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Rule 96, A.I. 113, A.I. 320-324, A.I. 613, Rule 16 bis.2 for refund processing and Rule 15.4/16.2/40.2(c)/37 CFR 1.446 for fee apportionment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time limits and extensions to pay international filing/search/transmittal fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules allowing extensions/late payment, one-month extension set by RO when RO finds deficiency, and late payment fee rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Rule 16 bis, Rule 16 bis.1, Rule 16 bis.2, and Art./Rule references for extensions and one-month set by RO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deposited biological material — particulars on separate sheet and time limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for indicating deposited biological material on a separate sheet and applicable time limits and U.S. regulatory references.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Rule 13 bis, A.I. 209 and references to microorganism deposit indications and time limits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Description — headings for parts, sequence descriptions, U.S. regulation
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for the arrangement and headings of parts of the description, special rules for nucleotide/amino acid sequences, and U.S. regulations applying.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Art. 5 Rule 5; Rule 5.2 A.I. Annex C; 37 CFR 1.435; A.I. 204 for amendments before IPEA.

rubrics_metrics.name: Design subject matter — not mentioned as subject matter for IA
rubrics_metrics.description: Design (as in industrial design) is not mentioned as subject matter for an international application under PCT Art. 2(i).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Art. 2(i) and related commentary for scope of IA subject matter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Designated Office procedures — amendment of claims/description/drawings before DO; communications
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for DO to handle amendments under Article 28 and communications to/from IB regarding elections and IA communications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Art. 28 Rule 52; Art. 39; Rule 19.4 A.I. 333 for transmission procedures and DO acceptance/rejection policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Flowsheets and diagrams considered as drawings; numbering and missing drawings procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: Flowsheets/diagrams are treated as drawings and must comply with drawing rules; RO procedure for missing drawings and time to file where drawings not necessary for understanding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Rule 7.1, Art. 7 Rule 7, Rule 20.5, A.I. 310, Rule 7.2 and 37 CFR 1.437 (U.S.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Election(s) and elected (EO) Office notifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on election of Offices (EO), notifications to IB of numbers filed after national stage deadlines, and U.S. treatment as elected Office.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See A.I. 112, 37 CFR 1.414 and cancellation of elections ex officio by IB/IPEA (A.I. 423, A.I. 606).

rubrics_metrics.name: Errors and rectification — obvious mistakes and processing by authorities
rubrics_metrics.description: Rectification rules for obvious mistakes by RO/IB/IPEA, notifications, consequences (e.g., IA held withdrawn), and who may or may not make ex officio corrections.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Rule 13 ter.3, Rule 29.1, Rule 38, Rule 92.4, Rule 60.1, Rule 49.5(g), Rule 90.4(c), A.I. 325/327/329/413/419 for guidance on rectification and ex officio limits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invitation to correct — process by IB or RO and processing by IB
rubrics_metrics.description: When and how authorities (IB/RO) invite applicants to correct defects and how IB processes such invitations and responses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Rule 26 ter.2(a), Rule 26 ter.2(b), A.I. 419, A.I. 413 for invitation and processing rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Entitlement to apply for a patent; entitlement to claim priority; exceptions to lack of novelty
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for who is entitled to apply, to claim priority, identify inventor(s), and what exceptions to lack of novelty may apply.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Rule 4.17 and Rule 51 bis.1(a) and A.I. 211-215 for entitlement/priority/novelty exception guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identity of inventor and inventorship rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and correction procedures for inventor identity and inventorship, including corrections for deceased/inapt inventors under U.S. rule.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Rule 4.17(i)-(iv), A.I. 211-214, 37 CFR 1.43, 1.45, 1.421(b) for U.S. practice on inventorship and joint inventors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-prejudicial disclosures (exceptions to novelty loss)
rubrics_metrics.description: Definitions and treatment of disclosures that do not prejudice novelty (e.g., certain prior disclosures allowed under national law), and how they are handled in the PCT context.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Rule 4.17(v), Rule 51 bis.1(a)(v), A.I. 215 and related commentary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ex officio corrections not to be made by RO or IB
rubrics_metrics.description: Certain ex officio corrections should not be made by the RO or IB, with references to applicable A.I. provisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See A.I. 327(d) and A.I. 419(c) for non-ex officio correction limits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Demand for International Preliminary Examination (IPE) — filing and defects
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for filing a demand for IPE, applicant entitlement to make a demand, defects in the demand, proof of right to file, and processing when filed with wrong IPEA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Rule 54, Rule 61.1, Rule 60.1, A.I. 614, A.I. 418, Art. 31 Rule 53, and Rule 59.3 guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice and publication of demand and recording of changes by IB
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for notices sent by IPEA about late filing, publication of demand notice, and recording changes to applications by the IB.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See A.I. 601, Rule 61.4, Rule 92 bis, A.I. 422, Rule 54 bis and 37 CFR 1.480 for notification practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time limit for making deposits and U.S. regulation
rubrics_metrics.description: Time limits for making deposits of biological material and U.S. rules that may apply.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Rule 13 bis and A.I. 209 and cross-references to U.S. regulations where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Headings and arrangement of contents/elements of IA
rubrics_metrics.description: Required arrangement and headings for parts of the IA (request, description, claims, drawings) and numbering conventions (three sets for request/description/drawings).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Art. 5 Rule 5, Rule 11, A.I. 207, A.I. 307 and physical requirements under Rule 11 and 37 CFR 1.433/1.431.

rubrics_metrics.name: Marking and physical requirements of IA (sheet numbering, line numbering)
rubrics_metrics.description: Physical requirements for IA sheets: numbering of sheets and lines, separate numbering sets, marking each sheet, and Ipub requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Rule 11, Rule 48, A.I. 207, A.I. 307, A.I. 410, A.I. 311, and 37 CFR 1.433/1.431 for U.S. specifics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication of IA — timing and effects; publication number
rubrics_metrics.description: International publication of IA promptly after 18 months from priority date (unless earlier requested) and publication numbers (WO) and effects (including provisional rights in U.S.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Art. 21 Rule 48, Art. 15, A.I. 406/805, A.I. 404, 35 U.S.C. 154(d) and related MPEP notes on U.S. effects (A.I. 404).

rubrics_metrics.name: International Search (IS/ISR) — establishment, time limits, and communications
rubrics_metrics.description: ISA obligations to establish an ISR, time limits for searching, methods for identifying cited documents and indications of relevance, and transmittal to IB/DOs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Rule 42, Rule 44, Rule 45, Art. 16/17, Rule 35/36, A.I. 420/503/505/508, 37 CFR 1.413/1.445 and Rule 72 for ISR communications and content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indications of claims and special categories in ISR
rubrics_metrics.description: The ISR should indicate citations' relevance to claims and any special categories of documents cited (e.g., earlier patent documents, non-patent literature).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See A.I. 505, A.I. 507, A.I. 508 and the ISR format rules for indicating relevance and categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subject matter not required to be searched
rubrics_metrics.description: Certain subject matter is excluded from search obligations under the PCT (e.g., nontechnical subject matter), with guidance on how ISA handles these cases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Rule 39 and Rule 42 and A.I. notes for categories excluded from search and IPEA/ISA minimum requirements (Rule 44 bis).

rubrics_metrics.name: International-type search and top-up searches
rubrics_metrics.description: Provisions for international-type searches and top-up searches (e.g., by IPEA), including scope and rules under Art. 15(5)(a), Rule 4.12, Rule 41.1 and Rule 66.1 ter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Art. 15(5)(a), Rule 4.12, Rule 41.1, Art. 35 Rule 70 and IPEA top-up search guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventive step/obviousness determinations (IPER/IPER guidance)
rubrics_metrics.description: Considerations for inventive step in IPER/IPER guidelines and how the IPEA/ISA should address inventive step/non-obviousness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Art. 32, Rule 65, Art. 33(3), Rule 70/73 and A.I. 604, A.I. 605 for guidance on explanations in IPER and method of identifying cited documents (A.I. 611).

rubrics_metrics.name: IPEA procedures — competence, lack of unity, minimum requirements, non-examinable subject matter
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules governing IPEA competence, handling of lack of unity determinations, minimum requirements for demands, and non-examinable subject matter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Rule 59, Art. 32, Rule 68, Rule 67, Rule 61.1, Rule 69.1 and 69.2; 37 CFR 1.416, 35 U.S.C. 362 for U.S. practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: IPER / Written opinion by IPEA — issuance and communication
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for IPEA to establish an International Preliminary Examination Report (IPER), written opinions, and communication/transmittal of IPER to applicant and IB.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Rule 70, Rule 73, Rule 71, Art. 34/36 and A.I. 605 for issuance, content guidance, and transmittal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Processing and recording of changes by IB — notifications and recordkeeping
rubrics_metrics.description: IB obligations to record application changes and notify relevant authorities about status, numbers, and late-stage occurrences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See A.I. 601, A.I. 422, Rule 61.4, Rule 92 bis, and A.I. 420 for recordkeeping and notification rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Language of IA, demand, forms, and correspondence
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules specifying what language the IA, demands, forms, and applicant correspondence must be in, and translations where required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Art. 11(1)(ii), Rule 12, Rule 48.3, Rule 72, Rule 43.4, Rule 12.3, Rule 49.2, Rule 9, A.I. 103, A.I. 104, and A.I. 501 for language & translation protocols.

rubrics_metrics.name: Later elections and later-submitted sheets — RO procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for later elections submitted after the demand and later-submitted sheets; how RO processes these submissions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See A.I. 309, A.I. 310 and Art. 24 for later elections and sheets procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Loss of effect of IA in designated states (consequences similar to withdrawal)
rubrics_metrics.description: Circumstances and consequences where an IA loses effect in designated states, equivalent to withdrawal of IA, and prohibited expressions consequences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Art. 24, Rule 29, Rule 90 bis.2 and related commentary on consequences and prohibited expressions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mail service irregularities — rules for service and consequences
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules governing mail service, irregularities, and risk allocation for deadlines and notifications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Rule 82 and related A.I. provisions for handling mail irregularities and evidence of service.

rubrics_metrics.name: Microbiological rules and nucleotide/amino acid sequence listing minimum documentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific minimum documentation required for nucleotide/amino acid sequence listings and microbiological deposit information in ISA/IA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Art. 15(4), Rule 34, Rule 13 ter, A.I. Annex C, A.I. 335 and U.S. regulatory cross-references.

rubrics_metrics.name: Numbering conventions — claims, sheets, lines, amendments
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for numbering of claims, numbering of sheets for IA and Ipub, numbering of lines on a page, and numbering of amendments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Rule 20 (claims), A.I. 207/A.I. 410/A.I. 311, Rule 11.7/11.8 and A.I. 205 for numbering conventions and amendment numbering practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing — request, demand, PCT filing formats, and computer-generated filing
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules governing filing of IA request and demand forms, acceptable PCT filing formats, computer-generated filings, and U.S. practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Rule 3.1, Rule 53.1(a), A.I. 102(h)&(i), A.I. Annex A and related A.I. entries for electronic/computer-generated filing guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: International Bureau (IB) functions — publication, transmittal to authorities, patent information services
rubrics_metrics.description: IB administrative functions including publication of IA, transmission to ISA/IPEA/DOs, patent information services, schedule of fees and changes to PCT regulations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Art. 21 Rule 48, Rule 87, Art. 50, Rule 86, A.I. 406/407/805 and A.I. Annexes D/E for IB duties and services.

rubrics_metrics.name: International filing date and effects; provisional rights in U.S.
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on how filing date is accorded, legal effects of the IA filing date, and provisional rights in the U.S. associated with publication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Art. 13/29, Art. 21, Art. 15, A.I. 404 and 35 U.S.C. 154(d) and A.I. discussion of national effects (U.S.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Transmittal of priority documents to IB and EO
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for transmitting priority documents to IB, ISA, and EOs, and requests for certified copies where applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See A.I. 323 and Rule 17.1 and A.I. 706 for pre-conversion and national stage translation/fee transmittal procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Entry into national stage (U.S.) — requirements, timing, and effects (35 U.S.C. 371)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and timing for entry into the U.S. national stage under 35 U.S.C. 371, including amendments and oath/declaration requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See 37 CFR 1.495, 1.491, 1.496, 35 U.S.C. 375 and Rule 52, Rule 78, Rule 23 references; see 37 CFR 1.497 for oath/declaration (Rule 91).

rubrics_metrics.name: National Office examination and national requirements allowed under Article 27
rubrics_metrics.description: National Offices may apply certain national requirements under Article 27(1),(2),(6),(7); national examination procedures differ and produce different results.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Art. 27, Rule 51 bis and country-specific guidance; see A.I. notes for U.S. differences (Art. 42, Art. 43, Art. 44 commentary).

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification and transfer rules for preliminary examination fee and related documentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for notifying/transfer of fees related to preliminary examination, handling fee, and refund requests.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Rule 58, Rule 57, Rule 58 bis, Rule 16 bis.2, Art. 22, 35 U.S.C. 376, 37 CFR 1.492 and A.I. Annex G.

rubrics_metrics.name: Topical guidance: method of identifying documents cited in IPER/ISR
rubrics_metrics.description: Standard method and guidelines for identifying and listing documents cited in the IPER and ISR, including explanatory guidance for examiners.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See A.I. 611, Rule 72, and A.I. 604 for guidelines on explanations and identification methods in reports.
